# Tests that CI is allowed to skip.
#
# Every skipped test not listed here fails the build (scripts/ci/test-report-guard.py).
# An empty file is therefore strict zero tolerance, which is the target state —
# an entry here is a debt, not a setting.
#
# Format, one per line:
#
#   com.example.SomeIT              # whole class: why, and the issue tracking it
#   com.example.SomeIT#oneMethod    # a single method
#
# The reason is mandatory. A skip nobody can explain is the exact failure this
# guard exists to end (#203), so declaring one costs more than deleting it.

com.vi.tenantservice.api.LiquibaseSchemaDriftIT # Gated on LIQUIBASE_IT_DB_URL, which CI never sets; #204 converts it to Testcontainers, and this line goes with it.
